name: Cross-platform notes app with MCP and Git backup

mentions.name: Cross-platform notes app with MCP and Git backup
mentions.description: This app is a cross-platform note-taking application with MCP support, JSON export, and Git backup. It works on every platform and in the browser, and offers a focused mode that full-screens the app for distraction-free note typing.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on the notes app with MCP, JSON export and Git backup. Like Apple Notes, but works on every platform and in the browser. Offers focused mode where you can just full-screen the app and type your notes.
